---
title: "Figure 2 – Integrated kidney scRNA-seq atlas and spatial deconvolution overview"
author: "Xin Wang"
date: "2026-08-21"
output: html_document
description: >
  (A) UMAP of integrated kidney scRNA-seq datasets (0, 3, 7, and 28 dpi) annotated
      by major cell type, including proximal tubule segments (PT-S1/S2, PT-S3),
      distal nephron populations (DCT-TAL, TAL, CNT, DTL), collecting duct
      populations (PC, ICA, ICB, DegCD), urothelial cells (URO), endothelial cells
      (END), fibroblasts (FIB), and immune populations (NEU, MAC, B, T, NK, PL).
  (B) Dot plot of canonical marker genes used for cell-type annotation.
  (C) Stacked bar chart of cell-type composition across timepoints (0, 3, 7, 28 dpi).
  (D) RCTD-based spatial deconvolution scatterpie plots projecting cell-type
      composition onto representative tissue sections at uninfected (0), 1, 3, 5,
      7, and 28 dpi; black boxes indicate the cortical/medullary and papillary
      regions enlarged in E-H.
  (E-H) Representative paired H&E images (left), spatial deconvolution scatterpie
      (middle), and quantitative cell-type composition (right) for the renal
      cortex/medulla and renal papilla at 0 (E), 5 (F), 7 (G), and 28 dpi (H),
      illustrating the progressive loss of resident epithelial signatures and
      expansion of immune cell infiltrates during APN.

Input:
  Single-cell: Integrated_EpiStroImmCells_v020426/PIPSeq_EpithelialStromaImmMergeObjs_v02052026.rds
  Spatial:     Deconvolution_Six_V01262026/Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_v01262026.rds

Output: Results/Figures/Figure2/

Note: the "renal papilla" regions in E-H reuse the pixel bounding boxes that the
per-day scripts in Spatial/InterestingInfectedRegions/Updated_V01272026/ call
"Pelvic" regions. Double check that this is the intended anatomical region before
using these figures -- rename `RegionLabels` below if a different box is meant.

```{r load-data}
SCcells <- readRDS(paste0(SCIndir, "PIPSeq_Final_UsedForScanpy_v08212026.RDS"))
SCcells@meta.data %>% head()
DimPlot(SCcells, group.by = "AnnotationL1", label = TRUE, repel = TRUE)


Pyelonephritis_Infection <- readRDS(paste0(Spindir, "Pyelonephritis_Infection_Decovoluted_v01262026.rds"))
Pyelonephritis_Infection <- UpdateSeuratObject(Pyelonephritis_Infection)
Allimages <- names(Pyelonephritis_Infection@images)

# the spatial deconvolution meta.data still has the proportion column named
# "DegCD" (that reference hasn't been rebuilt/renamed) -- rename it so a single
# CelltypeOrder (using "hIC-PC") works for both the scRNA and spatial objects
colnames(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data)[colnames(Pyelonephritis_Infection@meta.data) == "DegCD"] <- "hIC-PC"

cat("scRNA cell type counts:\n")
```

## Shared setup: cell type order, colors, timepoints

```{r shared-setup}
# Major cell type order shared by every panel in this figure -- keep this in
# sync with the deconvolution reference used across the other spatial scripts.
CelltypeOrder <- c("PT-S1S2","PT-S3","DCT-TAL","TAL","CNT","DTL","PC","ICA","ICB","hIC-PC",
                    "URO","END","FIB","PL","NEU","MAC","T","B","NK")
CelltypeOrder <- CelltypeOrder[CelltypeOrder %in% unique(SCcells$AnnotationL1)]

timepoint_order <- c("0DPI", "3DPI", "7DPI", "28DPI")
timepoint_order <- timepoint_order[timepoint_order %in% unique(SCcells$DataSet)]

# Same palette used throughout the spatial deconvolution scripts, so cell type
# colors match between the scRNA panels (A-C) and the spatial panels (D-H).
paletteMartin <- c(
  "#0166d8", # PT-S1S2
  "#ec102f", # PT-S3
  "#3aa609", # DCT-TAL
  "#6524ff", # TAL
  "#f8d147", # CNT
  "#33FFFF", # DTL
  "#fd6ca0", # PC
  "#476ba5", # ICA
  "#fea27a", # ICB
  "#add465", # hIC-PC
  "#86ec5a", # URO
  "#FF0099", # END
  "#5cfdc4", # FIB
  "#feafda", # PL
  "#000000", # NEU
  "#FFFF00", # MAC
  "#fd5925", # T
  "#166d2a", # B
  "#a90aa1"  # NK
)
pal <- setNames(colorRampPalette(paletteMartin)(length(CelltypeOrder)), CelltypeOrder)

Idents(SCcells) <- factor(SCcells$AnnotationL1, levels = CelltypeOrder)
```

```{r fig2b-dotplot, fig.width=14, fig.height=6}
  "Cyp4a14","Slc22a6", "Slc7a12",                 # Proximal tubule cells (PT), S1/S, S3

  "Umod","Slc12a1","Cldn10",                      # Thick ascending limb cells (TAL)
  "Klk1","Slc8a1","Calb1",                        # Connecting tubule (CNT)
  "Slc14a2","Fst","Bst1",                         # Descending thin limb cells (DTL)
  "Aqp2","Hsd11b2","Scnn1g",                      # Principal cells (PC)
  "Atp6v1g3",                                     # Intercalated cells 
  "Aqp6","Slc26a7",                               # Intercalated cells (A)

  "Cdh5","Igfbp3","Pecam1",                       # Endothelium
  "Col3a1","Fbn1","Col1a1",                       # Fibroblast
  "Ireb2","Alas2",                                # Plasmacytoid dendritic cells (PL)

  "C1qa","C1qb","Aif1",                           # Macrophage
```

## Figure 2C: Cell-type composition across timepoints

```{r fig2c-composition, fig.width=5, fig.height=4}
prop_df <- table(SCcells$DataSet, SCcells$AnnotationL1) %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  dplyr::rename(Timepoint = Var1, CellType = Var2) %>%
  filter(Timepoint %in% timepoint_order, CellType %in% CelltypeOrder) %>%
  group_by(Timepoint) %>%
  mutate(pct = prop.table(Freq)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    Timepoint = factor(Timepoint, levels = timepoint_order),
    CellType  = factor(CellType,  levels = CelltypeOrder)
  )

Fig2C_Prop <- ggplot(prop_df, aes(x = Timepoint, y = pct, fill = CellType)) +
  geom_bar(position = "stack", stat = "identity") +
  # scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
  labs(x = "Timepoint", y = "Proportion") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
   # plot.title  = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 10, face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 9)
  )

ggsave(paste0(Outdir, "Figure2C_scRNA_Composition.pdf"), plot = Fig2C_Prop, width = 4.5, height = 5.5)
Fig2C_Prop
```

## Helper functions shared by panels D-H

```{r region-helpers}
# One row per day x region -- the pixel bounding boxes are the ones already
# used in Spatial/InterestingInfectedRegions/Updated_V01272026/ for each day's
# "CortexMedulla" and "Pelvic" (labeled "Papilla" here) region scripts.
RegionConfig <- tribble(
  ~Day, ~OrigIdent,     ~Slice,   ~Region,          ~RowMin, ~RowMax, ~ColMin, ~ColMax,
  0,    "PyeloD0_1",    "slice1", "CortexMedulla",  160,     300,     320,     450,
  0,    "PyeloD0_1",    "slice1", "Papilla",        295,     420,     260,     350,
  1,    "PyeloD1_2",    "slice3", "CortexMedulla",  340,     NA,      230,     350,
  1,    "PyeloD1_2",    "slice3", "Papilla",        250,     320,     250,     310,
  3,    "PyeloD3_1",    "slice4", "CortexMedulla",  150,     280,     230,     350,
  3,    "PyeloD3_1",    "slice4", "Papilla",        250,     340,     250,     350,
  5,    "PyeloD5_2",    "slice7", "CortexMedulla",  200,     330,     280,     390,
  5,    "PyeloD5_2",    "slice7", "Papilla",        230,     400,     230,     280,
  7,    "PyeloD7_1",    "slice8", "CortexMedulla",  130,     270,     NA,      270,
  7,    "PyeloD7_1",    "slice8", "Papilla",        310,     450,     220,     330,
  28,   "PyeloD28_1",   "slice9", "CortexMedulla",  150,     320,     300,     550,
  28,   "PyeloD28_1",   "slice9", "Papilla",        350,     500,     210,     300
)

# Subset the deconvoluted object to one timepoint's slide, keeping only that
# slide's image.
subset_to_slide <- function(orig_ident) {
  slide <- subset(Pyelonephritis_Infection, orig.ident == orig_ident)
  keep_image  <- names(slide@images)
  drop_images <- Allimages[Allimages != keep_image]
  slide@images[drop_images] <- NULL
  slide
}

# Crop a slide object to a pixel bounding box. Slice-agnostic: filters on the
# generic imagerow/imagecol columns from GetTissueCoordinates() rather than a
# slice-specific "<slice>_imagerow" column name.
crop_bbox <- function(slide_obj, row_min, row_max, col_min, col_max) {
  coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(slide_obj)
  coords$barcode <- rownames(coords)
  keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(coords))
  if (!is.na(row_min)) keep <- keep & (coords$imagerow > row_min)
  if (!is.na(row_max)) keep <- keep & (coords$imagerow < row_max)
  if (!is.na(col_min)) keep <- keep & (coords$imagecol > col_min)
  if (!is.na(col_max)) keep <- keep & (coords$imagecol < col_max)
  subset(slide_obj, cells = coords$barcode[keep])
}

# Cell-type proportion matrix (ordered columns) for a (sub)object
celltype_matrix <- function(obj) {
  missing_cols <- setdiff(CelltypeOrder, colnames(obj@meta.data))
  if (length(missing_cols) > 0) {
    stop(
      "celltype_matrix(): CelltypeOrder has columns not present in obj@meta.data: ",
      paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "),
      ". If you just edited CelltypeOrder or the DegCD->hIC-PC rename, ",
      "re-run the load-data and shared-setup chunks before this one."
    )
  }
  mat <- obj@meta.data[, CelltypeOrder] %>% as.data.frame()
  colnames(mat) <- ordered(colnames(mat), levels = CelltypeOrder)
  mat[, CelltypeOrder]
}

# H&E-only panel: the tissue image with spots hidden (alpha = 0)
plot_HE_only <- function(obj, slice_name, title = NULL) {
  SpatialDimPlot(obj, images = slice_name, group.by = NULL, alpha = 0) +
    # labs(title = title) +
    theme(
      # plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
      legend.position = "none"
    )
}

# Scatterpie panel overlaid on the tissue image
plot_scatterpie <- function(obj, slice_name, title = NULL) {
  mat    <- celltype_matrix(obj)
  coords <- GetTissueCoordinates(obj)
  coords$barcode <- rownames(coords)
  common <- intersect(rownames(mat), coords$barcode)
  mat    <- mat[common, ]
  coords <- coords[common, ]
  df <- cbind(coords[, c("imagecol", "imagerow")], mat)

  base <- SpatialDimPlot(obj, images = slice_name, group.by = NULL, alpha = 1)

  basefinal<- base +
    geom_scatterpie(
      data = df,
      aes(x = imagecol, y = imagerow, r = 2.8),
      cols      = colnames(mat),
      color     = NA,
      linewidth = 0,
      alpha     = 1.2
    ) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal, breaks = names(pal)) +
    scale_y_reverse() +
    coord_fixed() +
    theme_void() +
    theme(legend.position = "none") +
    # labs(title = title) +
    theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"))
  return(basefinal)
}

# Cell type frequency barplot within a (sub)object

plot_freq_barplot <- function(obj, title = NULL) {
  mat <- celltype_matrix(obj)
  celltype_sums <- colSums(mat)
  freq <- celltype_sums / sum(celltype_sums)
  df <- data.frame(CellType = names(freq), Frequency = freq)
  df$CellType <- ordered(df$CellType, levels = rev(CelltypeOrder))

  p <- ggplot(df, aes(x = CellType, y = Frequency, fill = CellType)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = pal) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = percent_format()) +
    labs(title = title, x = "Cell type proportion") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      plot.title      = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 9, face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x     = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "none",
      panel.grid      = element_blank(),
      # axis.title.x    = element_blank(),
      axis.title.y    = element_blank()
    ) +
    coord_flip()
  p
}
```

## Figure 2D: Spatial deconvolution overview across timepoints, with region boxes

```{r fig2d-overview, fig.width=15, fig.height=9}
DaysForOverview <- c(0, 1, 3, 5, 7, 28)

Fig2D_panels <- lapply(DaysForOverview, function(d) {
  # d=0
  cfg   <- RegionConfig %>% filter(Day == d)
  slide <- subset_to_slide(unique(cfg$OrigIdent))
  slice_name <- unique(cfg$Slice)

  p <- plot_scatterpie(slide, slice_name, title = paste0(d, " dpi"))
  p
})

Fig2D <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = Fig2D_panels, nrow = 1, ncol = 6)
ggsave(paste0(Outdir, "Figure2D_Spatial_Overview_ScatterpieWithBoxes.pdf"),
       plot = Fig2D, width = 15, height = 4)
Fig2D
```

## Figure 2E-H: Paired H&E / scatterpie / composition for cortex-medulla and papilla

```{r fig2e-h-regions, fig.width=12, fig.height=6}
DaysForZoom  <- c(0, 5, 7, 28)
PanelLabels  <- setNames(c("Figure2E", "Figure2F", "Figure2G", "Figure2H"), DaysForZoom)

ZoomPanels <- list()

for (d in DaysForZoom) {
  cfg   <- RegionConfig %>% filter(Day == d)
  slide <- subset_to_slide(unique(cfg$OrigIdent))
  slice_name <- unique(cfg$Slice)

  region_rows <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(cfg)), function(i) {
    reg_cfg   <- cfg[i, ]
    reg_crop  <- crop_bbox(slide, reg_cfg$RowMin, reg_cfg$RowMax, reg_cfg$ColMin, reg_cfg$ColMax)

    # match freq_panel's panel aspect ratio (height / width) to the
    # coord_fixed() spatial panels, so all three render at the same height
    crop_coords  <- GetTissueCoordinates(reg_crop)

    he_panel   <- plot_HE_only(reg_crop, slice_name, title = paste0(reg_cfg$Region, " – H&E"))
    pie_panel  <- plot_scatterpie(reg_crop, slice_name, title = paste0(reg_cfg$Region, " – deconvolution"))
    freq_panel <- plot_freq_barplot(reg_crop, title = paste0(reg_cfg$Region, " – composition"))

    cowplot::plot_grid(he_panel, pie_panel, freq_panel, nrow = 1, rel_widths = c(1, 1, 0.7))
  })

  panel <- cowplot::plot_grid(plotlist = region_rows, nrow = 1, ncol = 2, rel_widths = c(1, 0.9))
  panel_name <- PanelLabels[[as.character(d)]]
  ZoomPanels[[panel_name]] <- panel

  ggsave(paste0(Outdir, panel_name, "_", d, "dpi_CortexMedulla_Papilla.pdf"),
         plot = panel, width = 15, height = 5)
}

ZoomPanels[["Figure2E"]]
ZoomPanels[["Figure2F"]]
ZoomPanels[["Figure2G"]]
ZoomPanels[["Figure2H"]]
```
